_comment: Frozen rendered-contrast debt on the public pages, one entry per text run that is below its WCAG floor (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text and icon glyphs) or that the walker cannot measure, wholly or in part — a `ratio` of null with a reason means a background image or gradient sits between the run and its ground, and those are frozen too rather than skipped. One entry covers a whole selector, and a selector is not always one element: `ratio` answers for the instances of it the walker could read, and `unreadable` counts those it could not, so text hidden behind a picture cannot drop out of the check by sitting beside a readable sibling. `sample` is a piece of the text the ratio was measured on. The ratchet blocks any new or worse run, and the count is ratcheted the same way; the baseline only goes down. Regenerate with `CONTRAST_UPDATE=1 pnpm --dir e2e exec playwright test contrast-ratchet`, which will not add a key the baseline has never seen unless CONTRAST_FREEZE_NEW=1 is set as well. The rule and its messages live in frontend/scripts/contrast-ratchet-core.mjs.
